records.evidence_text: The official Reigate 2017 Voting Summary publishes Total votes 4,109 and Number of ballot papers issued 4,109. It does not publish Number of ballot papers rejected.
records.notes: Calculated from two values explicitly published on the same official result page. This is not an officially published rejected-ballot value, does not populate rejected_ballots, and does not change completeness.

rules.notes: Calculated only where the same official Surrey result page publishes Seats=1, Total votes and Number of ballot papers rejected. This is not an officially published issued-ballot value, does not populate ballot_papers_issued, and does not change completeness.

The same official Surrey Voting Summary publishes Seats=1, Total votes=3,383 and Number of ballot papers rejected=21. The calculated issued-ballot value is separate metadata and does not populate the official field or completeness.
